error.invalidRequest: The setup request is invalid. Review the entered values and try again.
error.internalError: The setup service encountered an internal error. No success is assumed; try again.

access.unlockDescription: Enter the one-time code from the secure file indicated by the server. The server grants access with a temporary cookie.
access.unlockFailed: The code was not accepted. Request a new code or try again.
access.unlockUnavailable: Setup service is unavailable. Try again.
access.unlockContract: The setup response could not be verified. Try again.
access.unlockError: Setup could not be unlocked. Try again.
access.readyDescription: The server is ready for the next setup step.

administrator.title: Create the first administrator
administrator.description: Create the local administrator account used to finish setup. The password is sent only with this request.
administrator.alreadyConfigured: An administrator is already configured. Refresh setup status before continuing.
administrator.usernameInvalid: The administrator username is not valid. Review it and try again.
administrator.setupLocked: Setup access is locked. Unlock setup before creating the administrator.
administrator.createFailed: Could not confirm whether the administrator was created. Refresh setup status before trying again.

administrator.title: Administrator setup
administrator.pending: The data services are ready. Administrator account configuration is the next setup step.

optional.title: Optional configuration
optional.pending: Administrator setup is complete. Optional server settings are the next setup step.

optional.description: Confirm the external access address, retention, and mail now, or adjust them later in Settings.

publicAccess.title: External address
publicAccess.description: The current installation address is used by default. Enter another address only when HertzBeat is exposed through a load balancer, reverse proxy, or gateway.
publicAccess.useProxy: Use a load balancer or proxy
publicAccess.proxyPublicBaseUrlHelp: Enter the complete address used by users and external systems, including the scheme and any custom port or path prefix.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Set the number of days to retain data, or leave it empty to configure later.

mail.title: Mail server
mail.description: Configure SMTP delivery or skip it. A failed connection test does not block setup completion.

optional.saveRejected: The optional configuration was rejected. Verified status permits a safe retry.
optional.saveUncertain: Could not confirm whether the optional configuration was saved. Refresh setup status before trying again.

validation.mailConnectionFailed: The mail connection failed. You may correct it or skip mail configuration.
validation.failed: Validation failed. Review the entered values.
validation.unavailable: Validation is unavailable. No result is assumed.
validation.contract: The validation response could not be verified.
validation.error: Validation failed. No result is assumed.

warning.external_apply_required: External configuration must still be applied.
warning.restart_required: A server restart is still required.
warning.public_address_plaintext: The public address uses unencrypted HTTP.
warning.h2_non_production: The H2 database is intended only for local evaluation.

complete.title: Complete setup
complete.description: Review and acknowledge every server warning before finishing setup.
complete.rejected: Setup completion was rejected. Verified status permits a safe retry.
complete.uncertain: Could not confirm whether setup completed. Refresh setup status before trying again.

configuration.title: Connect data services
configuration.description: Configure the management database separately from the telemetry store. Each connection is checked against the server before it is applied.

management.title: HertzBeat management database
management.description: Stores HertzBeat users, monitors, alerts, and other management records.
management.h2Warning: H2 is for local evaluation only. Use MySQL or PostgreSQL for a durable deployment.
management.kindUnsupported: Management database type is not supported
management.schemaMismatch: Management database schema is not compatible
management.insufficientPrivileges: Management database user has insufficient privileges
management.validationFailed: The management database could not be validated. Check the fields and try again.

telemetry.title: GreptimeDB telemetry store
telemetry.description: Stores the metrics, logs, and traces collected by HertzBeat.
telemetry.credentialsHint: Username and password are optional, but must be provided together.
telemetry.validationFailed: The telemetry store could not be validated. Check the fields and try again.

configuration.applyManagedHint: HertzBeat will write the managed configuration. Passwords are cleared after each request.
configuration.applyExternalHint: HertzBeat will prepare an external configuration operation. Entered secrets remain only in this browser until the export is downloaded or this page is left.
configuration.submitFailed: The configuration request failed. Review the fields and try again.
configuration.operationFailed: The configuration operation failed or was rolled back. Server recovery is required before continuing.
configuration.externalApplyRequired: Apply the generated configuration outside HertzBeat, then wait for the server status to converge.
configuration.externalResumeRequired: This browser no longer has the original configuration or secrets. Re-enter every connection field and validate both services to generate a fresh export.
configuration.applicationStarting: HertzBeat is starting with the new configuration. This page will continue checking the server operation.
configuration.recoveryRequired: Configuration recovery is required. The current server state is preserved; follow the server recovery guidance.
configuration.migrationInProgress: The management database migration is in progress. Do not interrupt the server.
configuration.pollUnavailable: Operation status is temporarily unavailable. HertzBeat will not assume the configuration succeeded.
configuration.pollContract: The operation status response could not be verified. HertzBeat will not assume the configuration succeeded.
configuration.pollError: The configuration operation could not be checked. Retry after confirming the server is reachable.
configuration.configReadOnly: The managed configuration is read-only. Use the external configuration workflow.
configuration.configWriteFailed: HertzBeat could not write the managed configuration. The current configuration was preserved.
configuration.configRecoveryRequired: The configuration write requires server recovery before it can be retried.
configuration.operationConflict: Another setup operation is already active. Wait for it to finish before retrying.

export.title: Export external configuration
export.description: Download one server-rendered format and apply it outside HertzBeat. The download may contain secrets.
export.unavailable: The export service is unavailable. Try again.
export.contract: The export attachment could not be verified and was not downloaded.
export.failed: The external configuration could not be exported. Try again.

aiWorkspace.title: AI workspace
aiWorkspace.description: Investigate live HertzBeat data and review every proposed action before it runs.

empty.title: What do you want to investigate?
empty.description: Ask about a monitor, entity, alert, metric, log stream, trace, or topology scope.

composer.label: Investigation prompt
composer.placeholder: Ask HertzBeat to inspect an operational problem…

aiWorkspace.failure: The investigation stream is unavailable. No action was assumed to have completed.
aiWorkspace.sessionLoadIncomplete: Some saved investigation details could not be loaded. Refresh or select the investigation again.
aiWorkspace.recoveryRequired: The tool may have completed, but HertzBeat could not save the result. Check the target before continuing.
aiWorkspace.targetMismatch: This investigation target is no longer valid. Return to its source and start a new investigation.
aiWorkspace.targetUnavailable: HertzBeat cannot verify this investigation target right now. No investigation was started.
aiWorkspace.invalidTarget: This investigation link has an invalid or unsupported target. Return to the source page and start again.
aiWorkspace.activeObservationPaused: Live observation paused. The durable run is still in progress; no completion was assumed.

providers.title: Model providers
providers.description: Configure the model connections available to the HertzBeat AI runtime.
providers.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the existing key.

aiSchedules.title: Scheduled investigations
aiSchedules.description: Run a fixed investigation on a schedule and deliver the result through configured notification receivers.

states.emptyDescription: Create a schedule to run the same investigation and notify the same receivers automatically.
states.mutationFailed: The schedule change could not be confirmed. Refresh before trying again.

editor.name: Name
editor.cronHint: Six-field Spring cron; seconds must be 0
editor.templateHint: A custom template requires receivers of one type
editor.defaultTemplate: Use each receiver type's default template

transcript.title: Run history · {{name}}
transcript.empty: This schedule has not produced a transcript yet.
